# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 23 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launch & Resale Market Snapshot

- **October 2026 new private home sales surge to 1,716 units** - Developer sales rebounded sharply in October 2026, with 1,716 units sold (excluding ECs), a 479.7% jump from September's 296 units and the highest monthly volume since October 2025, led by Thomson Reserve and Lucerne Grand. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/october-2026-developer-sales/)

- **98% of Marina One Residences resale sellers recorded losses, with a median loss of $339,000** - Of 46 resale transactions at Marina One Residences in the 12 months to 18 October 2026, 45 sold below the owner's purchase price, compared to just 5.2% of condo resales islandwide recording losses. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/marina-one-residences-45-46-resales/)

## HDB Resale & Rental Trends

- **Clementi 4-room HDB flat sells for a record $1.38 million** - A 1,001 sq ft four-room flat at Block 445B Clementi Avenue 3 transacted at $1.38 million ($1,379 psf) in November 2026, setting the highest price ever recorded for a four-room resale flat in Clementi. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/clementi-crest-4-room-flat-sets-1-38m-record-at-1379-psf/)

- **Condo rental volumes ease in October 2026 while HDB rents continue to climb** - Condo leasing activity slowed further in October 2026, with HDB rental volumes holding largely unchanged; the year-end holiday season is expected to keep overall leasing activity subdued. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-rental-activity-slows-down-in-october-2026-as-hdb-rents-continue-to-climb/)

## Commercial & Investment

- **Asia Pacific hotel transactions hit a seven-year high in 2026** - Hotel deals across Asia Pacific reached US$12.0 billion from January to September 2026, the highest level since 2019, with Singapore contributing significantly through three sales including Crowne Plaza Changi Airport. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/asia-pacific-hotel-deals-hit-their-highest-level-since-2019/)
